preconditions.description: The number of necklace parts is between 1 and 5 * 10^5, inclusive.
The colors of pearls in each necklace part are non-negative integers less than 2^20.

postconditions.description: The maximum possible beauty of a necklace is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(output_permutation[i] in range(1, 2 * n + 1) for i in range(2 * n))
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output permutation is a valid index between 1 and 2n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(output_permutation[i] != output_permutation[i + 1] for i in range(2 * n - 1))
postconditions.description: No two consecutive integers in the output permutation are the same.
The function find_max_beauty, given the output permutation and input colors, returns the maximum possible beauty of the necklace.

invariants.description: The number of necklace parts is equal to the length of input_colors.
Each necklace part contains exactly two pearls.

invariants.expression: all(0 <= part[0] < 2^20 and 0 <= part[1] < 2^20 for part in input_colors)
invariants.description: The colors of pearls in each necklace part are within the specified range.
